title: Vodice Transfers | TAXI Bernard
description: Fixed-price transfers from Vodice to Šibenik, Split, Zadar, Skradin, Zagreb, Dubrovnik and Makarska. No taxi meter, no surprises. Book directly with Bernard.
keywords: vodice transfers, taxi vodice sibenik, taxi vodice split, taxi vodice zadar, taxi vodice skradin

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a Vodice transfer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Advance booking is recommended to guarantee availability, especially during peak summer season. You can book directly through the contact page.

mainEntity.name: Is the price per person or per vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: The price is per vehicle, not per person. It covers up to 4 passengers and luggage at no extra cost, with a small additional fee for 5 or 6 passengers.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a one-way or round trip ride?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both options are available. Just let Bernard know your plans when booking, and he'll arrange the pickup time that works for you.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer hotel or address pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Bernard will pick you up directly from your hotel, apartment, or any address in Vodice, no need to meet at a central location.

mainEntity.name: Can I make a stop along the way?

acceptedAnswer.text: Short stops can usually be arranged, just mention it when booking so Bernard can plan the route and timing accordingly.

mainEntity.name: What if my destination isn't listed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No problem, contact Bernard directly through the contact page with your destination for a custom price quote.
